company.name: Vecindario
company.shortDescription: Vecindario simplifies global real estate transactions with its comprehensive software platform.
company.description: A platform to help during the whole process of buying new housing which seeks to eliminate the issues that may arise in the process.

productsAndServices.description: A comprehensive real estate platform that facilitates and integrates the sale process of new housing, including tools for creating digital channels, managing inventory, generating reports, and integrating with financial institutions for digital housing credit management.
productsAndServices.name: Vecindario Suite

productsAndServices.description: Tools to create or optimize digital channels to receive more qualified leads and bring them closer to the sales team, including inventory manager, contact forms, scheduler, simulator/quoter, landing builder, prospect pipeline, and internal portal for prospects.
productsAndServices.name: Prospect Solutions

productsAndServices.description: Tools to accompany businesses until the delivery of the property and improve the user experience, including inventory manager, reservation payment, input management for linkage, payment of fees/installment payments, connection to PQRS systems, notifications to buyers, business manager, and internal portal for buyers.
productsAndServices.name: Sales and Business Management Solutions

productsAndServices.description: Tools to ensure the financial capacity of prospects and clients and improve the financial closing of projects, including financial scoring, loan pre-approval request, and housing loan request.
productsAndServices.name: Financial Solutions

productsAndServices.description: A tool to professionalize sales management by setting business rules in quotes and allowing advisors and users to generate customized payment plans quickly.
productsAndServices.name: Vecindario Builder

productsAndServices.description: A tool to analyze the financial profile, capacity, and behavior of clients to determine the probability of obtaining a housing loan, including scoring, credit history, reported income, financial expenses, and projected mortgage disbursement value.
productsAndServices.name: Vecindario Scoring
